items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry arriving while the first copy is still being handled so both pass the set check before either inserts the id.
Gap 1 says the dedup key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and a replay with a changed header id is processed again.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, so refunds never reach the handler.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrency within the one queue.
